owner_role: Lane 3 proposal; Lane 4 empirical stewardship handoff

primary_source.title: Demonstrating Large-Scale Package Manipulation via Learned Metrics of Pick Success
primary_source.hash_null_reason: Rendered primary source inspected; exact source bytes not archived.

observations.observation: Logged images and outcomes carry station, arm and tool metadata.
Failures are oversampled; centered and spatially varied picks are compared.
Learned success estimates rank candidates before feasibility filtering.
Malfunctioning suction cups motivate proposed health monitoring.

layer_mapping.null_reason: The inspected disclosure does not supply the matched three-cohort causal comparison.

deliberate_sampling_opportunity_cost.identifying_observation_needed: Displaced accepted service, time, labor, damage and contribution margins for assigned sampling slots.

sampling_intensity_per_operating_hour.identifying_observation_needed: Complete operating exposure and actual sampling allocation, including unsampled attempts.

marginal_useful_record_yield.identifying_observation_needed: Novelty, admissibility and downstream usefulness per additional record and opportunity.

failure_starvation_elasticity.identifying_observation_needed: Repeated exposure-adjusted useful-record arrivals as execution error changes, holding selection and processing fixed.

cross_cell_causal_transfer_kernel.identifying_observation_needed: Matched source-target transfers with permissions, configurations and ordinary learning controlled.

appropriable_share_of_learning_value.identifying_observation_needed: Beneficiary-specific incremental value and enforceable capture/appropriation terms.

lawful_cross_site_or_external_use_rights.identifying_observation_needed: Applicable use, retention, disclosure and transfer permissions; possession alone is insufficient.

suction_cup_wear_transition.identifying_observation_needed: Longitudinal physical-condition, replacement and maintenance histories; malfunction alone is insufficient.

wear_to_margin_elasticity.identifying_observation_needed: Matched wear, downtime, service, maintenance and contribution-margin observations.

successor_qualification_probability.identifying_observation_needed: All proposed successor procedures, qualified and failed, under a fixed protocol and evidence budget.

isolated_inquiry_procedure_lift.identifying_observation_needed: Fresh-site comparison with matched executor, information, evaluator, resources and carrier controls.

next_test_selection_changes.identifying_observation_needed: Versioned records of how inherited experience changes experiment selection and interpretation.

third_cohort_successor_procedure_lift.identifying_observation_needed: Randomized source history and post-production procedure passage; failed and absent successors retained.

accepted_service_robot_marginal_product.identifying_observation_needed: Matched capital counterfactual, horizon and service acceptance rule.

direct_successor_construction_cost.identifying_observation_needed: Dated attributable cash outlays and separately priced shared resource use.

incremental_recipient_stake.identifying_observation_needed: One-cohort incremental benefit before applying capture share theta, relative to competent ordinary learning and outside alternatives; exclude future successor value.

project_spendable_cash_and_receivables.identifying_observation_needed: Dated payer-specific outlays, collectible receipts, funding terms and every relevant cash prefix.

settlement_lag.identifying_observation_needed: Acceptance-to-collection timestamps for the relevant enforceable receipt, if this institution applies.

guaranteed_operating_refill_surplus.identifying_observation_needed: A supported lower bound on free operating cash after mandatory outlays and working-capital needs.

imitation_or_obsolescence_hazard.identifying_observation_needed: Matched opportunity survival before acceptance, separated from collection risk after acceptance.

joint_novelty_and_transfer_law.identifying_observation_needed: Joint source novelty and recipient benefit/harm outcomes; separate dashboards are insufficient.

P35_calibrated_activation_region.identifying_observation_needed: Joint identification or credible bounds for all required inputs; no parameter is filled from a synthetic witness.

next_observation_protocol.unit: fresh operating cell/cohort with explicit task and configuration
next_observation_protocol.cohort_1: Record a source history and the procedure artifact it changes.
next_observation_protocol.cohort_2: Assign the inherited history/procedure with a matched executor and resource/information budget; log all next-test choices and produced successor artifacts.
next_observation_protocol.cohort_3: Randomize passage of the incremental cohort-2 artifact after its production under a common announced passage probability; preserve all assigned failures.
outcomes: next-test efficiency under a declared cost measure
successor qualification and incremental third-cohort lift
exclusions: transmitted answers or extra raw target information
different lawful rights or evaluation budgets
post-treatment selection of only successful procedures

complementary_contractual_anchor.scope: contractual rights and payment architecture; learning and recursive effects remain open

claim_boundaries: Selected training failures do not identify the population failure rate.
Dataset composition does not identify operating-time sampling intensity.
Pick success is not successor qualification.
Malfunction is disclosed; a measured wear law and its cost are not.
Retraining and executor gains do not identify a better improver.
No P3.5 threshold or economic return is calibrated.
No new primary field data, confidential information, outreach or experiment was collected.

gate_status.A: Paper 3 analytical record controls; this packet is preparatory evidence
